scope: Primary sources for capability ports/adapters and one complete migration. No production changes in this research pass.
interpretation: Feasibility of one delivery and package ownership are repository-specific engineering conclusions; sources do not prescribe these package names or guarantee migration duration.

sources.title: Cockburn: original ports-and-adapters article
sources.supports: Separate application behavior from technology-specific interaction; several adapters can drive the same semantic application API.

sources.title: Go code review: interfaces
sources.supports: Interfaces generally belong to consuming packages; introduce contracts for actual use and return concrete implementations.

sources.title: Go: executing transactions
sources.supports: Group related changes in a transaction; avoid mixing non-transaction DB operations with transaction-bound operations.

sources.title: sqlc 1.31.1: transactions
sources.supports: WithTx binds generated queries to a transaction. The project retains BeginTx(ctx, nil) rather than the example context-free Begin.

sources.title: Fowler: refactoring
sources.supports: Small internal behavior-preserving changes can compose a larger restructuring. Release cadence is a separate project decision.

sources.title: Fowler: branch by abstraction
sources.supports: Temporary abstractions can support checked caller migration; remove old implementations and unnecessary migration bridges after replacement.

sources.title: Fowler: Unit of Work
sources.supports: The named pattern tracks affected objects and coordinates persistence/concurrency; a transaction callback alone is not the entire pattern.

sources.title: AWS: transactional outbox
sources.supports: Durable state and delivery intent avoid dual-write gaps; asynchronous consumers need duplicate and ordering handling.
